geometry.description: The geographical location of the address specified by latitude and longitude coordinates.

timeZone.description: The time zone associated with the address, typically in the format of a time zone identifier (e.g., 'Asia/Shanghai').

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

addressUsage.description:
Allows designation of use for parties with multiple addresses
i.e. billing address, work/office address (for a contact). etc

isPreferred.description:
Preferred postal address for a party
May be used for stored calc to replicate on party or partyRole

title:
Postal address and geo coordinates associated to a party.
currently only used by role of Contact
